detail.longDescription:
Migrating a site from 2 other, previous sites. One on Wix (🙄), the other on some ghastly, proprietary CMS cobbled together by a widely-hated Registrar Which Shall Remain Nameless.

Grabbing text from these systems — even from source view — is making me really, really happy about @bbedit@mastodon.social’s Text Factories, the (at last count) 30-step Factory I’ve assembled in it, each of which relies on my comfort with Regex/Grep. I’m no programmer, but some days it feels like I have a good chunk of the mindset (if not the actual skillset).

Also using Hazel to automate renaming image files, applying some sanity/consistency, lowercasing everything, “.JPEG” > “.jpg”, spaces-to-underscores, and adding dimensions.

These automations are saving me hours; it’s still going to have taken probably 3 days to move all of these blog posts over, because the manual part is making sure formatting, styling, and accessibility are done consistently. #WebDev #CMS #HTML
